summary: Frontend-only redesign verification of /workspace (Action Workspace). Logged in as testpro@test.com via /auth (not /login), navigated to /workspace. Page loads without crash. All required data-testids present: workspace-kpis, kpi-card-pipeline-influenced/revenue-pushed/actions-executed/offer-win-rate, workspace-activity-chart (recharts SVG rendered), workspace-view-switcher with view-switcher-list/kanban/timeline, record-header-progress-bar, workspace-connection (Salesforce demo connection detected — no-connection empty state therefore not shown, acceptable), workspace-queue, ai-draft-btn, save-draft-btn, all six kind-note/task/call/email/deal/offer pills. KPI values are derived from real /api/workspace/actions data ($0 pipeline influenced, $0 revenue pushed, 1/1 actions executed, 100% success rate, offer win-rate '—' since no offers). Chart renders area+line with a Sep 22 data point (Actions:1, Pipeline $:$0). View switcher toggles correctly between List (default), Kanban (with kanban-col-draft/executed/failed columns) and Timeline. Pill switching between all six action kinds works without errors. Existing composer intact (Attach to / deal selector present). Dark electric-blue glass theme preserved.
console_warnings: Hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <select>'. Root cause: Emergent visual-editor wrappers (data-ve-dynamic spans) inserted around <option> elements produced by providers.map in Workspace.js (~line 322-329) around workspace-provider-select. This is instrumentation-injected, not application code. No functional impact but produces recurring console warnings. If desired, could be silenced by moving the <select><option> outside the tracked wrapper or using a headless Select component (shadcn Select) instead of native <select>.
action_items: Optional: replace native <select> for workspace-provider-select and Attach-to/Salesforce-deal selects with shadcn Select component to eliminate the '<span> in <select>/<option>' hydration warnings caused by Emergent visual-editor span wrappers, OR mark those <option> elements to opt out of visual-editor instrumentation.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.js is 587 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold but acceptable. Consider extracting KpiRow, ActivityChart, QueueList/Kanban/Timeline into subcomponents for maintainability.
KPI/chart calculations correctly use useMemo over the real actions list — no fabricated numbers.
Composer render is correctly gated by write-CRM connectivity per spec.
Login route is /auth (not /login). The review request mentioned /login — updated test to use /auth (matches App.js routing).
test_credentials: testpro@test.com / password (via /auth toggled to Sign in mode using data-testid auth-toggle-mode)
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded action (1 executed HubSpot note on Acme).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page is at /auth and starts in 'Create account' mode — must click [data-testid=auth-toggle-mode] before filling email/password. All Action Workspace redesign testids verified. Two hydration warnings about span-in-option/select come from Emergent visual editor wrappers around native <select><option>, not real app bugs.
